sections.title: Minor Requirements
sections.note: Specific criteria for the minor are: Completion of five Anthropology courses, worth 3 credits or more. One of the five courses must be taken at the 1000- or 2000- level. (FWS do not count) Of the four additional courses, one must be at the 3000 level, and one must be a seminar at the 4000 level. One of the courses for the minor may be taken as transfer credit and one may be taken through study abroad. A minimum of three of the five required courses must be taken at Cornell.
